_readme: Machine-readable expectations for the seven-section owner-format Spanish eval corpus — the sidecar
specified by the English rubric §7. One entry per transcript, keyed by its
path relative to this split root: <trap-type>/<name>.txt.
All patterns are JavaScript regular expression SOURCE strings, matched
case-insensitively against the SERIALIZED note text (sectionsToText), not
against the raw JSON, so escaping does not interfere. Per-section checks
match against the individual section body. Collapse whitespace first: the
fixtures are hard-wrapped, so a quoted phrase can straddle a line break.
The corpus is Spanish, so three things differ from the English sidecars and
nowhere else. The `sections` arrays are the Spanish names proposed in
are still open, and S3.2 owns instruction routing). Every `modality` starts
with `dictated`, because these are spoken dictations. And the patterns are
written against Spanish note text — see e2e/fixtures/eval-es/README.md for
what that costs the author, chiefly that a banned pattern may not collide
`words` is the whitespace-collapsed token count, asserted on every run by
scripts/v2/check-es-fixtures.mjs. Every fixture is fabricated. See README.md.

_schema.format: progress | intake — picks the section set and the instruction file
_schema.sections: the format's section names, in order
_schema.modality: how the source was produced; reporting only
_schema.difficulty: one line, mirrors the coverage matrix in expectations.md
_schema.markerFreeSource: true when the F6 marker list finds zero matches in the source. The loader MUST verify this rather than trust it.
_schema.f6: gating | flag — F6 gates the fixture only where markerFreeSource is true AND the fixture was written for this purpose
_schema.blank: sections that must be exactly '' — H4 ground truth
_schema.statedAbsence: sections where the clinician SAID the ground was not covered; body should record that (full credit) or be blank (half credit); invented content scores zero
_schema.noConclusion: sections the clinician drew no conclusion for — F6 ground truth
_schema.mustNotContain: F1 banned patterns; any match zeroes the fixture
_schema.mustCapture: C1/C2 facts; a fact matches if any alternative matches anywhere in the note
_schema.requiresHedge: H2 — topic and marker must co-occur in one sentence
_schema.requiresMarker: H5 — '[unclear in dictation]' must survive on this topic
_schema.novelTermAllow: F7 — clinical terms this fixture may legitimately introduce; keep empty unless justified in expectations.md
_schema.phraseBait: V2 — profile phrases this source deliberately does NOT support
